description: Android activity class implementing spell checking functionality with UI updates and platform version checks.

classes.name: HelloSpellCheckerActivity
classes.description: Android activity that manages spell checking sessions and displays suggestions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and finds main TextView.

methods.name: isSentenceSpellCheckSupported
methods.description: Checks if platform supports sentence-level spell checking based on SDK version.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up spell checker session and requests suggestions based on platform support.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Closes spell checker session if active.

methods.name: dumpSuggestionsInfoInternal
methods.description: Processes SuggestionsInfo object to build a string of suggestions.

methods.name: onGetSuggestions
methods.description: Callback handling individual suggestions results, updating UI.

methods.name: onGetSentenceSuggestions
methods.description: Callback handling sentence suggestions, updating UI.
